proof_body:
by
  have pdf_int : ∀ a r : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < r → MeasureTheory.Integrable (ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal a r) ∧ ∫ x, ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal a r x = 1 := by
    intro a r ha hr
    have e : ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal a r = fun x => (ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDF a r x).toReal := by
      funext x
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDF, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal_nonneg ha hr x)]
    have hm : Measurable (ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDF a r) := (ProbabilityTheory.measurable_gammaPDFReal a r).ennreal_ofReal
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨MeasureTheory.integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top hm.aemeasurable ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ProbabilityTheory.lintegral_gammaPDF_eq_one ha hr]; exact ENNReal.one_ne_top
    · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_toReal hm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top), ProbabilityTheory.lintegral_gammaPDF_eq_one ha hr]; rfl
  have key_int : ∀ (a r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < r → (MeasureTheory.Integrable g (ProbabilityTheory.gammaMeasure a r) ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal a r x * g x)) ∧ ∫ x, g x ∂(ProbabilityTheory.gammaMeasure a r) = ∫ x, ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal a r x * g x := by
    intro a r g ha hr
    have e : ∀ x, (ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDF a r x).toReal = ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal a r x := fun x => by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDF, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal_nonneg ha hr x)]
    have hm : Measurable (ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDF a r) := (ProbabilityTheory.measurable_gammaPDFReal a r).ennreal_ofReal
    constructor
    · rw [ProbabilityTheory.gammaMeasure, MeasureTheory.integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul₀' hm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
      simp only [e, smul_eq_mul]
    · rw [ProbabilityTheory.gammaMeasure, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul₀ hm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
      simp only [e, smul_eq_mul]
  have mom : ∀ (a r s : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < r → 0 ≤ s → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) (ProbabilityTheory.gammaMeasure a r) ∧ ∫ x, x ^ s ∂(ProbabilityTheory.gammaMeasure a r) = Real.Gamma (a + s) / (Real.Gamma a * r ^ s) := by
    intro a r s ha hr hs
    have has : 0 < a + s := by linarith
    have hGa := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos ha
    have hrs : 0 < r ^ s := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr s
    have e : (fun x : ℝ => ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal a r x * x ^ s) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] fun x => (Real.Gamma (a + s) / (Real.Gamma a * r ^ s)) * ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal (a + s) r x := by
      have hne : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ≠ 0 := by simp [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
      filter_upwards [hne] with x hx0
      by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
      · have hxp : 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_ne hx (Ne.symm hx0)
        have hGas := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos has
        simp only [ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal, if_pos hx]
        rw [show a + s - 1 = (a - 1) + s by ring, Real.rpow_add hxp, Real.rpow_add hr]
        field_simp
      · simp [ProbabilityTheory.gammaPDFReal, if_neg hx]
    rw [(key_int a r _ ha hr).1, (key_int a r _ ha hr).2, MeasureTheory.integrable_congr e, MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae e]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := pdf_int (a + s) r has hr
    refine ⟨h1.const_mul _, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h2, mul_one]
  exact mom
target_source: ∀ (a r s : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < r → 0 ≤ s → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) (ProbabilityTheory.gammaMeasure a r) ∧ ∫ x, x ^ s ∂(ProbabilityTheory.gammaMeasure a r) = Real.Gamma (a + s) / (Real.Gamma a * r ^ s)
